description: This file defines the EmployeeService class in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manage employee data, including CRUD operations, event dispatching, and related business logic within the HR management context.

classes.name: EmployeeService
classes.description: Service layer class responsible for managing employee data and related events within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: getEmployeeDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeDao instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDao instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeEventService instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeTerminationService instance.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the IDGeneratorService instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee objects based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Counts employees matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Saves an employee and dispatches an event indicating the employee was saved.

methods.name: saveNewEmployee
methods.description: Generates a new ID and saves a new employee record.

methods.name: dispatchAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Dispatches events related to adding a new employee.

methods.name: updateEmployeePersonalDetails
methods.description: Updates personal details of an employee and logs the update event.

methods.name: updateEmployeeJobDetails
methods.description: Updates job-related details of an employee and logs the update event.

methods.name: dispatchJoinedDateChangedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event when an employee's joined date is changed.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee object by employee number.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the total number of employees, optionally including terminated ones.

methods.name: getEmployeeAsArray
methods.description: Returns an employee's data as an array based on employee number.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeesForWorkShift
methods.description: Fetches employees available for work shift planning based on filters.

methods.name: getUndeletableEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns employee numbers that cannot be deleted (e.g., current user and admin in demo mode).

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks if an email address is unique among employees.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Checks if an employee ID is unique.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees with specified employee numbers and dispatches a deletion event.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers for subordinates under a supervisor, including the chain.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Returns a list of subordinate Employee objects under a supervisor.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if an employee with given number is a supervisor.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Returns a list of supervisor employee numbers for a subordinate, including the chain.
